standard.summary: （实验性）小波 loss：通过多级小波分解分析训练输出的高/低频成分，对不同频率的重建误差差异化加权。
standard.effect: wavelet_loss_weight 控制总体小波 loss 权重；approx_weight 控制低频近似系数的权重（相对于高频细节系数）；levels 控制小波分解级数（更多级 → 分析更低的频率）。
standard.whenToUse: 实验性功能。对高频细节（纹理/线条清晰度）有要求时可以尝试，比纯 MSE 更能感知频率域的质量。
standard.avoidWhen: 默认关闭。小波 loss 的权重设置需要经验，设置不当可能导致频率不平衡。

standard_en.summary: (Experimental) Wavelet loss: it analyses the high and low frequency components of the training output through a multi-level wavelet decomposition and weights the reconstruction error differently by frequency.
standard_en.effect: wavelet_loss_weight controls the overall wavelet loss weight; approx_weight controls the weight on the low-frequency approximation coefficients (relative to the high-frequency detail coefficients); levels controls the number of decomposition levels (more levels -> analysis of lower frequencies).
standard_en.whenToUse: An experimental feature. Worth trying when you have requirements on high-frequency detail (texture, line sharpness), since it perceives quality in the frequency domain better than plain MSE.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Off by default. Setting the wavelet loss weight takes experience, and a poor setting can unbalance the frequencies.

advanced.principle: 离散小波变换（DWT）将信号分解为近似系数（低频，整体结构）和细节系数（高频，边缘/纹理）。多级 DWT（levels 级）逐级分解近似系数，提取越来越低的频率成分。loss = approx_weight × ‖WT_approx‖ + ‖WT_detail‖。
advanced.tradeoffs: wavelet loss 与 dct loss 有功能重叠（都分析频域），通常选择其中一种使用。DWT 计算复杂度略高于 DCT（但仍较快，约 2~5ms/step）。

advanced_en.principle: The discrete wavelet transform (DWT) decomposes a signal into approximation coefficients (low frequency, overall structure) and detail coefficients (high frequency, edges/textures). A multi-level DWT (levels) decomposes the approximation coefficients level by level, extracting ever-lower frequency components. loss = approx_weight × ‖WT_approx‖ + ‖WT_detail‖.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Wavelet loss overlaps functionally with dct loss (both analyze the frequency domain); usually pick one. DWT compute complexity is slightly above DCT (but still fast, about 2~5ms/step).
